information.title: Information
information.infoText: You will receive a medical certificate once assignment is complete and an appointment has been made with the health department
information.pleaseComeDepartment:
Please come sober on the day of your appointment:
{{ department }}
information.pleaseBring_heading: Bring the following documents with you to your medical examination:
pleaseBring_list: Completed medical history form (see download box)
Letter of assignment (letter from the employer stating the reason for the examination) with a copy
Copies of medical documents (e.g. hospital discharge reports, certificates, etc.)
Proof of currently prescribed medications (when applicable)
information.forAttests_heading: For certificates of exam eligibility, please bring the following with you
forAttests_list: We are only responsible for students in Frankfurt
Please arrive for exams no later than the day of the exam (even without an appointment) or when submitting an academic paper after making an appointment by telephone.
information.definitelyBring_heading: Please bring the following to your appointment
definitelyBring_list: Your medical records with diagnosis from your doctor
Certificate from your university or college regarding the examination date.
Student- or Personal ID, or Passport
Fee of 50 euros (payable with cash or debit card).

personalArea.title: Here you can report your concern for an official medical examination.
personalArea.information: To report a concern, a confirmation letter is needed
